desc: Establish optimal structure: all 1→0 flips precede all 0→1 flips (exchange argument); order by decreasing (down)/increasing (up) C.
Derive cost formula and prove optimal Q is a prefix of P sorted descending; reduce to per-prefix closed form.
Implement the O(N log N) algorithm (stdin→stdout) with PR/PS/g(c)/prefix-sum formula.
Execute the brute-force Dijkstra validator over 2^N states vs. the fast solver on exhaustive N≤4 and 3000 random N≤10 cases; no mismatches (ALL TESTS PASSED).
